layout.hierarchy: Title/subtitle are the largest text at the top; the colored neural-network diagram dominates the middle; bottom equation boxes are smaller supporting detail; the slide number is the smallest element.

visual_elements.description: Neural network diagram. Four small purple input dots under Input Sample feed three previous-layer nodes. Each processing node is a circle containing Σ followed by a small square with an activation symbol. Previous layer i has three blue/white nodes; current layer j has three green nodes. Weighted connections from previous outputs to current inputs are labeled W_ji. A magenta bias node labeled 1 connects into the current layer. Current-node inputs are labeled Net_j and outputs O_j. Outputs continue to Output 1, Output 2, Output m, then across a red vertical Error band to Class 1, Class 2, Class m. Target Label sits at the top right with a connector down toward the class column.
Pink/magenta rounded rectangle labeled Input Sample at the upper left of the diagram; four purple dots descend from it as the input vector.
Pink/magenta rounded rectangle labeled Target Label at the upper right; a thin vertical connector runs down toward the Class boxes.
Tall red vertical band between the output labels and the class boxes; the word Error is repeated three times as Error Error Error in white.
Yellow circular slide-number badge at the top right containing the numeral 3.

imagery: No photos or external images; only vector-style diagram icons: purple input dots, Σ circles, activation squares, magenta bias node, and colored rounded labels.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout, Arial/Calibri-like. Title is bold, large, dark red; subtitle is bold blue and enclosed in parentheses. Body labels are small black text; math variables are italic. Layer names sit inside colored rounded rectangles. The repeated Error text is white on red. The slide number is bold black on a yellow circle.
animation_state: Static; no mid-build state is evident.
recreation_brief: 1) Use a blank white slide. Add a light-gray panel from about 4% to 96% width and 17% to 71% height; fill #F2F2F2 with a thin black border. 2) Add the title text box near the top: Neural Network Model, Arial bold about 40 pt, color #C00000. Below it add: (Each node consists of Summation + Activation), Arial bold about 24 pt, color #0000FF. 3) Add a yellow oval at the top right, about 4% wide, with black bold text 3. 4) Inside the panel top-left, add a pink/magenta rounded rectangle labeled Input Sample. Below it draw four small purple dots in a vertical column and connect them to the first node layer. 5) Draw Previous Layer (i): three nodes around x 30%, at upper/middle/lower positions. Each node is a white circle with blue border #0070C0 containing Σ, followed by a small white activation square. Add a blue rounded label Previous Layer (i) and a blue up arrow labeled i. 6) Draw Current Layer (j): three nodes around x 55%, same vertical positions. Each node is a light-green circle #C6E0B4 with green border #00B050 containing Σ, followed by a small activation square. Above each node place italic Net_j; after each activation square place italic O_j. Add a green rounded label with the lines Current Layer is / Output Layer / (You are here), and a green up arrow labeled j. 7) Add a magenta bias node labeled 1 below the current layer and connect it to the three current-layer nodes. At the lower left add the legend: magenta circled 1 plus Node Bias. 8) Connect previous-layer outputs to current-layer inputs with thin lines and label the incoming weights W_ji with subscript j i. 9) To the right of the current nodes add small green rounded rectangles Output 1, Output 2, Output m. Add a tall red vertical band filled #FF0000 with white repeated text Error Error Error. At the far right add green rounded rectangles Class 1, Class 2, Class m aligned with the outputs. Add the pink Target Label rounded rectangle at the top right with a thin vertical line down toward the class column. 10) In the bottom-left pink box titled For Layer “j”, place the two formulas exactly as in the equations field. In the bottom-right pink box titled If Layer “j” is Output Layer:, place E = 1/2 ∑_j (t_j - O_j)^2. Keep the center layer-indicator boxes and i/j arrows. 11) Match colors: background white; panel #F2F2F2; title #C00000; subtitle #0000FF; body black; magenta #FF00FF; green #00B050 with light green #C6E0B4; blue #0070C0; red #FF0000; yellow #FFFF00; input dots #7030A0.
